regional_summary.pattern: Xscape is a nationwide Cineplex FEC brand (~81-83 locations). ZIv Canada curator LABcrab (2024-09, still accurate into 2026): almost every location is ticket-redemption oriented; only about 17 Xscape sites still had any dance games (mostly ITG2 or old DDR Extreme/SuperNOVA/X, plus rare PIU). Japanese ACG rhythm (maimai, chunithm, ongeki, sdvx, etc.) is effectively absent from Xscape.
regional_summary.mapping_note: In the Groove 2 has no dedicated slug in the valid list; reported as other. DanceDanceRevolution family uses ddr when present. Grand Piano Keys / Piano Keys are redemption and are not counted as music games.
